records.Name: Emergency Shelter
records.Description__c: Immediate safe-housing placement for survivors fleeing domestic violence. Up to 90 days per the residential contract; can be extended on a case-by-case basis. Family- and pet-friendly.

records.Name: Transitional Housing
records.Description__c: Longer-term housing support (6-24 months) bridging emergency shelter to independent living. Includes case management and self-sufficiency coaching.

records.Name: Crisis Hotline
records.Description__c: 24/7 confidential hotline for survivors in crisis. Trained advocates provide safety planning, resource referrals, and shelter intake.

records.Name: Court Advocacy
records.Description__c: Survivor accompaniment to court hearings, protective order petitions, custody/divorce proceedings, and victim impact statements. Not legal advice — emotional and procedural support.

records.Name: Legal Advocacy
records.Description__c: Referrals to attorneys, help filing protective orders, navigating the legal system. Coordinates with Indiana Legal Services for free representation when eligible.

records.Name: Children's Support Group
records.Description__c: Age-appropriate group programming for child witnesses of domestic violence. Play therapy, art-based processing, school coordination.

records.Name: Survivor Support Group
records.Description__c: Weekly facilitated peer group for adult survivors. Trauma-informed framework; safe space for shared experience and mutual support.

records.Name: Trauma-Informed Counseling
records.Description__c: 1:1 counseling with trauma-trained clinicians. Modalities include CBT, EMDR, somatic experiencing. SFTS partners with local licensed therapists when in-house capacity is full.

records.Name: Financial Literacy Class
records.Description__c: 8-week curriculum on budgeting, banking, credit repair, savings, and economic self-sufficiency. Tied to the 3-checkpoint Financial Counseling workflow.

records.Name: Self-Sufficiency Coaching
records.Description__c: 1:1 case management focused on the 10 SSM domains. Goal-setting, accountability, resource navigation. Drives the SSM Intake/Mid/Exit assessment cycle.

records.Name: Safety Planning
records.Description__c: Structured safety-plan development. Covers immediate-danger response, relocation logistics, technology/digital safety, custody-handoff protocols, and ongoing situational awareness.

records.Name: Community Outreach & Education
records.Description__c: Public-facing DV awareness: school presentations, church partnerships, professional trainings (medical/law enforcement/clergy), and the Cowboy Ball annual event.
